    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = grid[h-1-r][w-1-c]
    # Return only the rectangular missing region, as demonstrated.
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    return [row[c0:c1+1] for row in out[r0:r1+1]]
